parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a state-imposed universal-exposure regime: national passport/visa rules force sex-at-birth markers, visa officers are instructed to flag suspected sex 'misrepresentation' with a possible lifetime fraud finding, and ~22 state/provinces bar facility access with criminal liability in 4 (one documented arrest). Detention carries documented birth-sex placement and, per one source, hormone confiscation and abuse. These are tier-1 exposures every trans visitor carries. Mitigations: courts actively enjoin several orders, a hate-crime statute exists, marriage recognition stands, no sodomy law, no documented trans-specific violence against visitors, and most states retain no facility ban. Recourse is partially working but not yet reversing the operative rules. That places the jurisdiction in the Elevated Risk band, at its lower end.
